notes: Low byte of the constructor argument. No function reads it.
16 bit characters. The byte at buffer-1 is the share count (0 or 0xff: not shared). The block starts at buffer-2. 0 means empty (the shared empty buffer is 0x888b44).
0x10: PUSH 0x10 at 0x5c1c4e (wrapper new_TGString) and at 0x5dd8fa (wrapper TGModelProperty_GetName operator_new(0x10)).
